engines.name: LTX Generative Repair
engines.author: idocinthebox
engines.description: AI-powered generative video repair using LTX-Video diffusion models. Inpaint damaged frames, fill sprocket holes, and restore corrupted film regions with context-aware generation. Includes ProPainter batch repair and streaming export. Backends: OpenCV (built in), Cloud and Self-Hosted (unrestricted, Cloud needs your own LTX API key), and ProPainter (free separate install you perform yourself, NTU S-Lab License 1.0 - non-commercial use only).

engines.name: ATR Story Renderer
engines.author: idocinthebox
engines.description: Generate before/after demos and restoration report videos from ATR job artifacts. Includes FFmpeg + optional HyperFrames backend, alpha exports (ProRes 4444 / PNG sequence), HTML preview, and Resolve overlay pack helper.
